To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of machine learning techniques is an important and useful approach to the detection of road signs.
The most important factors for the performance of a traffic sign detection system are the quality of the input data (i.e. image resolution and lighting conditions) and the accuracy of the classifier.

the most popular machine learning techniques used for traffic sign detection are the neural networks, the most popular neural network architecture for road sign detection is the convolutional neural network (CNN), the most popular CNN architecture for road sign recognition is the VGG16 network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a system capable to detect road signs in real time.
the detection and recognition of traffic signs from images.
the development of an automatic road sign detection method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most successful methods for road sign detection are based on the combination of color and shape information, and the use of a cascade of classifiers.
the road sign detection is a very difficult problem and the existing methods are not yet able to provide a satisfactory solution to it.
the methods based on machine learning are more accurate than the methods based on neural networks, and the most accurate methods are those based on machine learning and neural networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed approach is able to detect road signs in images captured from an onboard camera, and it is robust to the changes in illumination conditions, the changes in the background and the presence of shadows.
, the existing methods are not sufficient to solve the problem of road sign detection.
the road sign detection methods can be classified into three main categories, namely, color based methods, shape based methods and feature extraction based methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the methods for automatic road sign detection have a great deal of room for improvement.
machine learning methods can provide a good performance in road sign detection.
there is no single algorithm that can be used for all road sign types and all driving conditions.
